notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
[h2]We're excited to roll out our next patch, featuring V-Sync, new graphics settings, and improved UX elements. Here's what’s new in this build:[/h2]

[h3]1️⃣No PCs in outer space[/h3] 
We've added [b][u]V-Sync[/u][/b], a [b]frame limiter[/b], and [b]resolution settings[/b] to help reduce CPU load and overheating. While some issues remain, we're actively working on a full fix.
[h3]2️⃣What's up with this wreath? [/h3]
We've introduced [b]more hints[/b] to guide you smoothly toward the game's finale.
[h3]3️⃣What did I miss? [/h3]
Probably the [b]puzzle clues![/b] We've added extra guidelines to help with in-game puzzles.


[h3]⏳ Update schedule change [/h3]
Future patches won’t be as frequent as the last two, as we're temporarily freezing work on Chapter 1 to focus on Chapter 2. Stay tuned on [url=https://discord.gg/StN5ymYHDy]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks, screenshots, and developer insights! [h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736840/The_August_Before/]Please wishlist[/url][/h3] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736840/The_August_Before/]our game[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736840/The_August_Before/]on our main page[/url]!

Thanks for your support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: 100+ Prologue Reviews
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for playing The August Before: Chapter 1![/h2]

We can't express how grateful we are for your time, reviews, and feedback. We are an indie studio, and this means a world to us — the patches will keep coming and we will keep fixing everything that can cause frustration or your PC to fly to outer space (certified UE5 moment)
[h3]
In the next patch on Monday, 17.03, you will see: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Graphics options: V-Sync, frame limiter, and resolution settings;
[*]bug fixes;
[*]UX improvements: Some players have trouble figuring out how to complete the game, and we've added some things to guide them.
[/list]

I also want to assure you, that this is just a Chapter 1; plenty of content awaits you in the future. We've talked about it on our [url=https://discord.gg/StN5ymYHDy]Discord [/url]server. It could be cool to see you there 

[h2]Don't forget to wishlist our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736840/The_August_Before/]main page[/url]!![/h2]

See you soon!

Hey everyone,

We're really happy to announce that The August Before: Chapter One is now available for free for everyone to enjoy!

Play through the first room as you clean August's room, pack up as she prepares to move on to college. Get to know about August's life and relationships as you pick which sentimental items to bring with her.

If you enjoy The August Before: Chapter One, please don't forget to [b]wishlist the full game[/b] to be notified when it releases this year!
